SADT complex: current proteins map exactly to AFE_2970 CysD1 and AFE_2971 CysNC; iMC507 original GPR retains ((AFE_2970 and AFE_2971) or (AFE_3124 and AFE_3125)), score 3. Rhea RHEA:18133 gives sulfate + ATP + H+ → APS + diphosphate; KEGG EC 2.7.7.4 and BioCyc agree as cross-references. A 2016 same-strain paper (DOI 10.13560/j.cnki.biotech.bull.1985.2016.02.017) reports cysD-1/cysNC co-transcription and recombinant enzyme activity among key candidate genes, but its public abstract does not identify which protein’s assay measured which precise substrate/product; do not use it alone to reassign reaction direction or subunit chemistry. Retain original iMC507 score 3. The 2003 genome reconstruction also associates cysNC2 with capsule neighborhood/suggested PAPS use; that role is a hypothesis, not a second confirmed activity.
